channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Ukraine oo mar labaad afar maalmood gudahood duqeysay kaydka saliidda ee Tatarstan
item.description: Diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee Ukraine ayaa Isniintan duqeeyay haamaha kaydka saliidda ee u dhow magaalada Almetyevsk ee gobolka Tatarstan ee Ruushka, waana weerarkii labaad ee aagaas ka dhaca afar maalmood gudahood, sida ay xaqiijisay dowladda gobolka.

item.title: Qaramada Midoobay oo baaritaan madax-bannaan ka dalbatay weerarka markabka Ruushka ee Libya
item.description: Ergada Qaramada Midoobay ee Libya (UNSMIL) ayaa Isniintan ku baaqday baaritaan degdeg ah, madax-bannaan oo hufan oo lagu sameeyo weerarradii diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee Axaddii lagu qaaday laba markab oo ku sugnaa xeebta Benghazi, oo uu ku jiro markab Ruush ah.

item.title: Cillad software oo dib u dhigtay in ka badan 1,000 duulimaad oo Delta, Jay Clayton oo ka digay cillado kale
item.description: Agaasimaha sirdoonka qaranka Maraykanka Jay Clayton ayaa ka digay in Maraykanku uu la kulmi doono cillado tiknoolajiyadeed oo kale, kadib markii cillad software oo ka dhacday saldhigga Delta Air Lines ee Atlanta ay Axaddii dib u dhigtay in ka badan 1,000 duulimaad.

item.title: Shirka caafimaadka bulshada Afrika ee CPHIA 2026 oo maanta ka furmaya Addis Ababa
item.description: Shirka Caalamiga ah ee Shanaad ee Caafimaadka Bulshada Afrika (CPHIA 2026) ayaa Isniintan, 23 November, ka furmaya magaalada Addis Ababa ee Itoobiya, iyadoo la filayo in ka badan 30,000 oo ergo ah oo ka kala yimid Afrika iyo meelo kale.

item.title: Indonesia: booliiska oo 24 boorso meyd ka soo saaray warshad nacnac oo dab qabsaday
item.description: Booliiska Indonesia ayaa 24 boorso oo meydad ah ka soo saaray warshad nacnac oo ku taal degmada Cikande ee jasiiradda Java kadib dab weyn oo Sabtidii qabsaday, iyadoo tobanaan shaqaale ah weli la la'yahay.

item.title: Kumanaan qof oo Istanbul ku mudaaharaaday cadaadiska mucaaradka iyo warbaahinta
item.description: Kumanaan qof ayaa Axaddii magaalada Istanbul ee Turkiga ku dhigay socod mudaaharaad ah oo looga soo horjeedo cadaadis sii ballaaranaya oo lagu hayo mucaaradka iyo warbaahinta madaxa bannaan, maalmo kadib markii booliisku telefishinka Sözcü TV weerar ku qaaday.

item.title: Detroit Red Wings oo Dylan Larkin u wareejisay Montreal Canadiens
item.description: Kooxda Detroit Red Wings ayaa Dylan Larkin, oo kabtankeeda ahaa tan iyo 2021, u wareejisay Montreal Canadiens, taasoo soo afjartay sheeko kala-guur oo socotay shan bilood.

item.title: Weerarro Ruush ah oo gobolka Kyiv lagu dilay ugu yaraan 12 qof
item.description: Mas'uuliyiinta Ukraine ayaa sheegay in duqeymo ay Ruushku ku qaadeen gobolka Kyiv ay ku dhinteen ugu yaraan 12 qof, iyadoo kooxaha samatabbixintu ay burburka ka baadigoobayaan dad nool.

item.title: Jets oo 27-24 kaga adkaatay Chargers, Justin Herbert-na la geliyay baaritaanka miyir-beelka
item.description: Kooxda New York Jets ayaa Axaddii 27-24 kaga adkaatay Los Angeles Chargers kulan NFL ah oo Los Angeles lagu ciyaaray, kadibna Chargers ayaa sheegtay in Justin Herbert la geliyay nidaamka baaritaanka miyir-beelka.

item.title: New York Giants oo 23-18 kaga adkaaday Jacksonville Jaguars kulan xiisad leh
item.description: New York Giants ayaa Axaddii garoonka MetLife 23-18 kaga guuleystay Jacksonville Jaguars toddobaadka 11-aad ee NFL, iyagoo ka badbaaday soo kabasho ay Jaguars ku sameeyeen qaybtii labaad.

item.title: Broncos oo 38-24 ku garaacay Raiders, Jonah Coleman oo saddex taabasho dhaliyay
item.description: Denver Broncos ayaa Axaddii garoonkooda Empower Field at Mile High 38-24 kaga adkaaday Las Vegas Raiders toddobaadka 11-aad ee NFL, iyadoo ciyaaryahanka cusub Jonah Coleman uu dhaliyay saddex taabasho (touchdown).

item.title: Trump oo dhaleeceeyay Schumer xilli Dimuqraadiyiintu ka doodayaan hoggaanka Golaha Guurtida
item.description: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa Axaddii sheegay inay aad ugu adkaan doonto inuu la shaqeeyo Chuck Schumer haddii loo doorto hoggaamiyaha aqlabiyadda Golaha Guurtida Mareykanka, xilli Senator Chris Van Hollen uu kula tartamayo Schumer hoggaanka Dimuqraadiyiinta.

item.title: Shirkii cimilada ee COP31 ee Antalya oo ku dhammaaday heshiis la'aan, khilaaf ku saabsan shidaalka
item.description: Wadahadalladii cimilada ee Qaramada Midoobay ee COP31, oo ka socday magaalada Antalya ee Türkiye, ayaa ku dhammaaday iyadoo aan la gaarin go'aankii guud ee shirka, kadib markii wadan-wadaxaajoodyadu ku heshiin waayeen in dukumentiga lagu xuso shidaalka dhulka laga qodo.

item.title: Cali Cabdullaahi Cosoble, madaxweynihii ugu horreeyay ee Hirshabeelle, oo ku geeriyooday Qaahira
item.description: Cali Cabdullaahi Cosoble, oo ahaa madaxweynihii ugu horreeyay ee dowlad goboleedka Hirshabeelle, ayaa Axaddii ku geeriyooday magaalada Qaahira ee dalka Masar isagoo 65 jir ah, kadib xanuun loogu qaaday dalkaas.

item.title: Trump oo casho gaar ah u sameeyay milkiilayaasha ugu waaweyn ee lacagtiisa dhijitaalka ah
item.description: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa Axaddii casho gaar ah oo saddexaad u qabtay milkiilayaasha ugu badan ee lacagta dhijitaalka ah ee $TRUMP, taasoo dib u kicisay su'aalaha ku saabsan isku dhaca danaha ganacsigiisa iyo xilka madaxweynenimo.

item.title: Tarik Skubal oo la sheegay inuu Mets la galay heshiis 450 milyan oo doollar ah, kan ugu weyn tuuraha
item.description: Kooxda New York Mets ayaa la sheegay inay heshiis sagaal sano ah oo qiimihiisu yahay 450 milyan oo doollar la gaartay tuuraha Tarik Skubal, kaasoo noqonaya heshiiska ugu weyn ee abid tuure baseball-ka loo saxiixo.

item.title: Burgos oo gool is-dhalin ah ku garaacday Albacete, joojisayna guulihii xiriirka ahaa
item.description: Burgos ayaa Axaddii 1-0 kaga adkaatay Albacete kulan ka tirsan horyaalka heerka labaad ee Isbaanishka, iyadoo goolka keliya ee kulanka uu ahaa gool is-dhalin ah oo uu dhaliyay ciyaaryahanka Albacete ee Neva.

item.title: Atlético Madrid oo ka adkaatay Getafe, Simeone oo noqday tababaraha guulaha ugu badan ku leh La Liga
item.description: Atlético Madrid ayaa Axaddii garoonka Coliseum ku garaacday Getafe kulan ka tirsanaa wareegga 13-aad ee La Liga, guushaas oo Diego Simeone ka dhigtay tababaraha guulaha ugu badan ka gaaray taariikhda horyaalka Isbaanishka.

item.title: Le Mans oo Vélodrome kaga soo laabatay 2-0, kagana adkaatay Marseille 3-2
item.description: Kooxda Le Mans ayaa Axaddii garoonka Vélodrome ku garaacday Olympique de Marseille 3-2, iyadoo dhaliyay saddex gool qeybtii labaad kadib markii ay nasashada ku jirtay 2-0, taasoo joojisay shan guulood oo xiriir ah oo Marseille ka gaartay Ligue 1.

item.title: Atalanta iyo Inter oo 4-4 ku kala baxay, Pio Esposito oo saddex gool dhaliyay
item.description: Kulan xiiso badan oo ka tirsanaa wareegga 12-aad ee Serie A ayaa Axaddii garoonka New Balance Arena ee Bergamo ku dhammaaday 4-4, kadib markii Franck Kessié uu Atalanta u dhaliyay gool barbareeya daqiiqadihii dheeraadka ahaa.

item.title: FIFA oo maanta la filayo inay u ansixiso Boqortooyada Ingiriiska martigelinta Koobka Adduunka Haweenka 2035
item.description: FIFA ayaa Isniintan, 23 November, la filayaa inay ansixiso in Ingiriiska, Scotland, Wales iyo Waqooyiga Ireland ay si wadajir ah u martigeliyaan Koobka Adduunka Haweenka 2035, oo noqon doona Koobkii Adduunka ee kubadda cagta ugu horreeyay ee Boqortooyada Ingiriiska ka dhaca tan iyo 1966.

item.title: Cowboys oo 51-30 ku garaacday Titans, natiijo aan abid ka dhicin NFL
item.description: Dallas Cowboys ayaa Axaddii 51-30 kaga adkaatay Tennessee Titans toddobaadka 11-aad ee NFL, natiijadaas oo ah markii ugu horreysay ee ay dhacdo 107-da sano ee taariikhda horyaalka.

item.title: Panthers oo 35-33 kaga adkaatay Ravens kulan xamaasad badan leh
item.description: Carolina Panthers ayaa Axaddii 35-33 ku garaacday Baltimore Ravens kulan NFL ah oo ay ka buuxeen khaladaad iyo isbeddello hoggaan, taasoo Panthers u sii xoojisay hoggaanka qeybta NFC South.

item.title: Lions oo 31-21 ku garaacay Buccaneers, guushoodii lixaad ee isku xigta
item.description: Detroit Lions ayaa Axaddii garoonka Ford Field 31-21 kaga adkaaday Tampa Bay Buccaneers toddobaadka 11-aad ee NFL, taasoo ahayd guushoodii lixaad ee isku xigta, iyadoo Jahmyr Gibbs uu la simay rikoor uu hore u lahaa Barry Sanders.

item.title: Gerwyn Price oo ku guuleystay Grand Slam of Darts, soo afjaray afar sano oo uu koob weyn la'aan ahaa
item.description: Ciyaaryahanka Welsh-ka ah Gerwyn Price ayaa Axaddii habeennimo magaalada Wolverhampton ee Ingiriiska ku guuleystay koobka Grand Slam of Darts, kadib markii uu finalka 16-11 kaga adkaaday Gian van Veen.

item.title: Chiefs oo 34-7 ku garaacday Cardinals, Mahomes iyo Kelce oo hormuud ahaa
item.description: Kansas City Chiefs ayaa Axaddii garoonkooda 34-7 kaga adkaaday Arizona Cardinals toddobaadka 11-aad ee NFL, iyadoo quarterback-ga Patrick Mahomes tuuray saddex touchdown, halka Travis Kelce uu laba jeer gaaray aagga dhibcaha.

item.title: Carlos Alcaraz oo Zverev ku garaacay finalka, kuna guuleystay koobkiisii ugu horreeyay ee ATP Finals
item.description: Ciyaaryahanka Isbaanishka Carlos Alcaraz ayaa Axaddii magaalada Turin ee Talyaaniga ku guuleystay koobka ATP Finals markii ugu horreysay, kadib markii uu finalka 6-2, 7-6 kaga adkaaday Alexander Zverev oo ah ciyaaryahanka kaalinta koowaad ku jira adduunka.

item.title: Hakan Çalhanoğlu oo ku dhaawacmay kulanka Atalanta iyo Inter, goolhayaha Carnesecchi oo isna dhaawacmay
item.description: Xiddigga khadka dhexe ee Inter Hakan Çalhanoğlu ayaa Axaddii qeybtii hore ee kulanka Atalanta ka baxay dhaawac muruq kadib, halka goolhayaha Atalanta Marco Carnesecchi uu kulanka ka hor ku dhaawacmay diyaar-garowga.

item.title: Warbixin loo diyaariyay Kongareeska Maraykanka oo ka hadashay muhiimadda istaraatiijiga ah ee Somaliland
item.description: Warbixin loo diyaariyay Kongareeska Maraykanka oo qiimeysay fursadaha xiriirka Washington iyo Somaliland ayaa sheegtay in Somaliland ay muhiimad istaraatiiji ah u leedahay amniga, ganacsiga iyo iskaashiga gobolka, iyadoo Maraykanku sii wado xiriirka tooska ah ee uu la leeyahay masuuliyiinta Somaliland.

item.title: NFL: DK Metcalf oo laga saaray kulanka Steelers iyo Eagles kadib markii uu ciyaartoy indhaha ku muday
item.description: Ciyaaryahanka Pittsburgh Steelers DK Metcalf ayaa Axaddii laga saaray kulankii ay kooxdiisu kula ciyaartay Philadelphia Eagles, kadib markii muuqaallo ay muujiyeen inuu farta indhaha kaga muday daafaca Eagles Cooper DeJean rubucii saddexaad.
